import logging
import pytest

@pytest.fixture
def setup_logging(caplog):
    caplog.set_level("INFO")
    logging.info("setup_message")
    yield
    logging.info("teardown_message")

def test_clear_with_multiple_phases(caplog, setup_logging):
    """Test that clear works correctly when there are records from multiple phases."""
    # At this point we should have setup records
    setup_records = caplog.get_records("setup")
    assert len(setup_records) == 1
    assert setup_records[0].getMessage() == "setup_message"
    
    # Add a call record
    logging.info("call_message")
    call_records = caplog.get_records("call")
    assert len(call_records) == 1
    assert call_records[0].getMessage() == "call_message"
    
    # Current records should only show call records
    assert len(caplog.records) == 1
    assert caplog.records[0].getMessage() == "call_message"
    
    # Clear should only affect current phase records
    caplog.clear()
    
    # After clear, call records should be empty but setup records should remain
    assert len(caplog.get_records("call")) == 0
    assert len(caplog.records) == 0
    assert len(caplog.get_records("setup")) == 1  # Setup records should still be there
    
    # Add another call record after clear
    logging.info("call_message_after_clear")
    assert len(caplog.get_records("call")) == 1
    assert caplog.get_records("call")[0].getMessage() == "call_message_after_clear"
    assert len(caplog.records) == 1
    assert caplog.records[0].getMessage() == "call_message_after_clear"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pytest
    pytest.main([__file__, "-v"])
